Strike · Romania

YARA J reports suspected drone strike and fire near Sulina; crew safe

14 October 2026 · YARA J near Sulina · suspected drone strike and fire

Fire confirmed; crew-reported drone strike and explosion under investigation

The Comoros-flagged tanker YARA J reported an onboard fire near Sulina on the evening of 14 October 2026. Its crew alleged a drone strike and explosion. The fire was extinguished and all reported 17 crew were safe.

The incident was reported about nine nautical miles east of Câșla Vădanei, in Romanian territorial waters. MRCC requested assistance at 20:25; that is a rescue timestamp, not an exact verified strike time. SAR Apollo departed at 20:31 and was recalled at 21:30 after the crew said help was no longer needed.

Authorities confirmed the fire, but drone causation remained under investigation. The defence minister said military radar had not detected a drone approaching the vessel. No operator has been identified, and a connection to the 20:04 incursions in N085 remains unproven. The alleged strike, fire and response are kept together as one record.
